rule: Each input has an official or licensed source URL and timestamp
Signal uses only information available before the line lock
Rules fixed on training seasons; tested on a holdout not used for design
At least N bets per strategy (N to be set by owner; e.g., 300 singles)
Positive CLV vs. the chosen closing benchmark (Q14)
Result survives correction for all strategies tested
Stable across season halves and not driven by one week
Leg correlation measured from data; parlay EV adjusted for it
Market is lawful for the user and not in a prohibited prop category as reported (Q12, Q13)
